name: Baked Sesame Beef with Broccoli, Red Pepper, Green Onion & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions in half crosswise. Chop the white and pale green parts into 1-inch pieces and divide between two large baking sheet pans. Thinly slice the dark green parts and set aside for serving.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; halve crosswise, then slice into thin strips. Add bell pepper and broccoli to the baking sheets with the green onion.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ (510 g) bags broccoli florets

instructions.primary_message: Pat steak dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch pieces. Add to the baking sheets.
Drizzle veggies and steak with stir-fry sauce and oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup stir-fry sauce
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and steak is cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide rice, steak, veggies, and sauce between plates. Sprinkle with reserved green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!
